decisions.evidence: Reviewed all displayed finite formulas: h>0 makes interpolation nodes distinct; ENO ties choose left without choice; minmod has its zero/sign branch; JS and Z denominators and normalization are strictly positive for epsilon>0, including constant data. Reflection k -> 2i+1-k supplies the opposite trace. Nodal and cell-average branches are separated. Characteristic reconstruction assumes an invertible real eigenbasis and asserts no system stability. Checked Jiang-Shu 1996 sections 2-3 and Don 2018 slides 6-9 (PDF pages 6-9): general p-power Z weights and tau5; p=2 is exactly the local squared formula. The reader adds source metadata and a p=2 clarification, with no changed mathematical mapping. No AC or unmet supplier.
Recomputed increments ±1/2, fluxes 0,3/4,1,1/4,0, updated entries -1/4,3/4,5/4,1/4 and variation 3>2.

Opened the complete current uniqueness and interpolation-remainder suppliers. Newton interpolation at all three distinct nodes is verified; the face lies within each triple, C3 holds on the larger closed interval, and each product magnitude is 3h^3/8. Remainder /3! gives Mh^3/16, also for ties.

Opened Taylor bound. Candidate moments of degrees 0–2 and combined moments through degree 4 cancel as displayed. Distances are at most 3h and absolute coefficient sums are 10/3 and 23/15, giving the stated constants 15 and (23/15)3^5/5!.

Read every step and definition supplier. Nonzero d_i gives both minmod ratios in [0,1]; d_i=0 forces both increments zero, avoiding division by zero. Thus C_i lies in [mu/2,3mu/2], including endpoints, and the increment update yields TVD by nonnegative summation and absolute convergence; periodic N=1 is explicit. Checked reflected negative-speed update and a=0 or dt=0. Recomputed tent fluxes: A=1/2-3mu/4, B=1-mu/4, C=1/2+3mu/4, D=mu/4, so TV=3mu on (2/3,1]. N>=7 separates copies. Source Droniou section 3.3 concerns a sufficient CFL; sharpness is independently established locally, not attributed to it. No choice or missing supplier.

Taylor averaging gives M2*h^2/24; adjacent increments are h*uprime+O(M2*h^2). The lower derivative bound fixes signs for small h and either limiter branch has the same error. Both faces have O(h^2) error, including M2=0.
Recomputed the two slopes -1/2 and fluxes 1,3/4,-1/4,0. Updated entries 9/8,1/2,-1/8 have variation 3/2 and exceed both range endpoints.
Quadratic averages and opposite increments ±h^2 give zero slope and exact face error h^2/6 for every h>0.

(source addition plus supplier-quote enrichment). Checked C1/C2 difference bounds, beta=O(h^2), positive fixed epsilon and normalization: JS weights differ by O(h^2), Z by O(h^4). Zero-sum weight errors multiplied by O(h^3) candidate errors give O(h^5)/O(h^7), then the ideal O(h^5) estimate. Reflection and constant data are covered; no epsilon(h) claim is made. Read Shu §2.2.2 equations (2.50)–(2.64), PDF pages 18–21, and Jiang–Shu §§2–3 formulas (2.9)–(3.9), PDF pages 4–6.

Read all three steps and all four current suppliers. Exact affine average x_i-a*t gives adjacent increments h and minmod slope one; every WENO candidate equals the face value by the degree-two moment lemma, so ideal/JS/Z normalization returns it. Both reflected traces agree. Flux differences are a*h for either sign of a, giving the exact next average; a=0 is stationary. This exact affine identity requires no global boundedness, finite TV, CFL or general nonlinear stability assertion, and no such supplier is invoked. The second/fifth-order suppliers are compatible local smoothness observations. No AC, reader/refuter defect or unmet prerequisite.

Independently integrated the five cubic cell averages and recomputed the three candidates, all three exact indicator polynomials, weighted mean -47/5 and nonzero JS coefficient 54/95 with rational arithmetic. The common leading Z correction cancels, leaving O(h^3) weight deviations and O(h^6) state error. Positive h^4 denominators and separate fixed-epsilon regime are explicit. Read Henrick–Aslam–Powers §§4.2–4.5, printed pp. 552–554; their finite-difference result is context, not a substitute for this face-state computation.

Read all five verification steps and all seven actual suppliers, including the full current entropy-convergence proof. Datum is bounded/local L1 with translation variation one and infinite global L1 norm. F(a,b)=a^2/2 is a globally locally Lipschitz and diagonally consistent extension, monotone on [0,1]^2 with L1=1,L2=0. h_m=1/m,tau_m=h_m/2 has lambda=1/2, positive lower ratio and full CFL. AC_omega is inherited through convergence, weak-limit and contraction; DC-only integrable branch is unused. Directly computed speed 1/2, entropy jump k^2-k on [0,1] and zero outside, and trace error at most t/2 on each compact. All initial slopes vanish and first right average is 1/4, agreeing with the exact shock. Convergence is asserted only for the monotone baseline, never the subsequent MUSCL evolution. Droniou sections 2.3.1-2.3.3 and 3.3 read; local current supplier proof rather than source authority establishes this application. No current mathematical gap found.
